why: Pins the WIRING, not the helper: holdAimFor can be correct and fully unit-tested while decideAi quietly discards its result, which would leave every unit test in aim-hold.test.ts green and the shipped game completely unchanged. The write-back pair is deliberately left intact here so the mutation is a pure 'result ignored', not a type error. Failure count went 2 -> 3 when issue #371 added dispatch.test.ts's barrel-arrival case, which also depends on the held angle reaching the trigger.

aim hold (issue #344) decideAi returns the HELD aim angle, not the fresh solution, while the span is live
